appearance_facts.fact: A blue line with circular markers connects data points from left to right across the plot area, accompanied by a light blue shaded region beneath the line.

The line begins near the top-left corner of the plot area, remains relatively flat for the first several points, then slopes steeply downward to the right, continuing a gradual descent toward the bottom-right corner.
The y-axis is labeled 'Count' with tick values increasing downwards from 0 at the top to 1400 at the bottom.
The x-axis displays date labels ranging from 'Jan 27, 2020' on the left to 'Mar 22, 2020' on the right, with labels rotated diagonally.

printed_facts.fact: The chart title is 'Month vs. Number of cases'.
The y-axis label is 'Count'. The tick marks are labeled 0, 200, 400, 600, 800, 1000, 1200, 1400 from top to bottom.

The line starts at a y-value near 0 (top) around Jan 27/Mar 02. It drops to approximately y=300 around Mar 09. It reaches approximately y=550 around Mar 10. It reaches approximately y=750 around Mar 11. It reaches approximately y=1000 around Mar 16. It reaches approximately y=1350 (bottom) around Mar 22.
